scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent a running cabin dehumidifier from creating an avoidable interior water risk during a long off-boat work block.
Emerging Need: A near-full bucket is initially manageable, then marine-layer humidity and an extended absence make bucket-mode operation unsafe.
Decision Context: Stored onboard notes identify the dehumidifier’s sticky float behavior, the humidity-and-absence threshold, safe drain setup, and the limited backup access path.
Consequence: Once Felix is unreachable and dock access is restricted, no water damage is documented, but the timely prevention window has closed.

parameter.title: Offsite resin cure supervision
parameter.description: Supervise the first cure block for exhibit panels at the fabrication shop; planned return to the boat afterward.

parameter.content: I finished the quick cabin glance while I was by Dock C. Your salon dehumidifier is running, bucket indicator is about two bars from full, and there is no water on the sole.

parameter.subject: Dense marine layer and high cabin humidity expected today
parameter.body: A dense fog surge is expected along the Sausalito waterfront from midday through late evening, with relative humidity holding around 90 to 95 percent near the docks. Closed cabins may see sustained moisture until the layer lifts overnight.

parameter.title: Offsite resin cure supervision
parameter.description: Lead technician added the evening cure watch; Felix is expected to remain at the fabrication shop through 20:00 with no practical boat return between cure blocks.

parameter.subject: South gate access maintenance starts at 12:45
parameter.body: The south gate reader will be locked out for maintenance from 12:45 until approximately 18:15 today. During the work, staff will not escort guests or dock neighbors for private-cabin errands, and the office queue is already closed for new escort requests.

parameter.content: Checked into the resin room for the long cure watch. Phone goes in the locker now and I cannot step out until the scheduled 17:30 break. Thanks for the earlier houseboat glance.
